newsitem.title: USA: Micron stock falls on rumors, presentation cancelled.
newsitem.headline: Micron stock falls on rumors, presentation cancelled.

text.p: Shares of Micron Electronics Inc. fell Tuesday on a flurry of rumours after the computer maker cancelled a presentation at the Smith Barney Technology conference that day, traders said.
Micron fell $5.375 to $18.362 on Nasdaq, where it was the sixth-most active issue on volume of almost 7.8 million shares.
A Smith Barney spokeswoman could not immediately comment. Micron spokesmen were in a meeting and did not return calls.
Traders cited speculation that Micron might announce that business was not going well or that earnings might be below Wall Street's current expectations.
